quotes.quote:
The way to get started is to quit talking
and begin doing.
quotes.author: Walt Disney

quotes.quote:
Optimism is the faith that leads to achievement.
Nothing can be done without hope.
quotes.author: Helen Keller

quotes.quote:
It always seems impossible
until it's done.
quotes.author: Nelson Mandela

quotes.quote:
The secret of getting ahead
is getting started.
quotes.author: Mark Twain

quotes.quote:
A journey of a thousand miles
begins with a single step.
quotes.author: Lao Tzu

quotes.quote:
Success is the sum of small efforts,
repeated day in and day out.
quotes.author: Robert Collier

quotes.quote:
Believe you can,
and you're halfway there.
quotes.author: Theodore Roosevelt

quotes.quote:
In the middle of difficulty
lies opportunity.
quotes.author: Albert Einstein

quotes.quote:
The future depends on
what you do today.
quotes.author: Mahatma Gandhi

quotes.quote:
Great things are done by a series
of small things brought together.
quotes.author: Vincent van Gogh

quotes.quote:
Act as if what you do makes a difference.
It does.
quotes.author: William James

quotes.quote:
A small goal completed today
can become tomorrow's great victory.
quotes.author: Anonymous

quotes.quote:
Storms pass,
and the sun rises again.
It's okay to rest for a while.
Move at your own pace.

You don't have to be perfect today.
Showing up is enough.

Pause, breathe,
and begin again when you're ready.
A small step still moves you forward.
Be a little kinder to yourself today.

Your difficult day
does not define your tomorrow.

The road is still there
even when you stop to rest.

Let one warm thought
stay with you today.

You are allowed to choose
what hurts your heart less today.

Your quiet effort
is still taking root.

Trust the person who has stayed with you
through every day: yourself.

Good things can arrive slowly
and still arrive on time.

One kind word can warm
the coldest moment.

A simple action now
is stronger than a perfect plan later.

Even if today feels uncertain,
you can take the next gentle step.

On lonely days,
be firmly on your own side.
